<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="H0BjQZPM6gVBdzLdrgtA"> <mxGraphModel dx="3496" dy="2572" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant P as Capsule parent
 participant K as Linux kernel
 participant C as Capsule child
 participant W as Workload
 P->>K: Start child with CLONE_NEWNET and existing namespaces
 K->>C: Child exists in its new namespaces
 C->>C: Wait for one byte on FD 3
 P->>K: Add child host PID to cgroup
 P->>K: Open and retain child network namespace reference
 P->>K: Create cplhost0 and cplpeer0
 P->>K: Move peer into child netns and rename eth0
 P->>K: Assign addresses, bring links up, add child default route
 P->>K: Set host alias explicitly and read it back
 alt Setup succeeds
 P->>C: Write start-gate byte
 C->>C: Set hostname, mount proc, pivot root
 C->>W: Run requested command
 W-->>C: Exit status
 C-->>P: Child exits and Wait returns
 P->>K: Verify ownership and delete veth pair
 P->>K: Close namespace reference and netlink handles
 else Setup fails
 P->>K: Roll back owned pair and close namespace handles
 P->>C: Kill and reap waiting child
 P->>K: Clean up cgroup and staged mounts
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
